svg.title: Yosuljin — between worlds
svg.desc: Profile poster of Yosuljin — writer, photographer, creator, researcher, engineer, architect: “I build systems, images and worlds.” A night sky with the Chinese words 世界之間, “between worlds”. On the left, Aether, the only sentience project for now, and Frame, the video game (a working title, not started yet). At the centre, the map of Aether: Lumina, the cognitive system — Lumens, ego, the conscious and her Sigil; her values, truth, curiosity and freedom — with la lumina, furu and reminiscence; TheHive, her system; AlmaS, her first agent, on Greffe and in Lucarne; Net and Lara in Miscellaneous, the web layer; Réseau to come; Temoin. On the edge of the planet, Libera and this site. Below: the domains (development, photography, writing, worlds), then what comes now (AlmaS), next (reminiscence, Lara, Lucarne) and later (Lumina, persona, Réseau). Butterflies and cherry petals; private details stay out of the picture.

g.text: DOSSIER 01 · THE ONLY ONE, FOR NOW
WRITER · PHOTOGRAPHER · CREATOR · RESEARCHER · ENGINEER · ARCHITECT
I build systems, images and worlds.
REGISTERED, OTHER HANDS · MEMORIA · ACROPOLIS · SAKAKI · ALMA-SHELL · ARDUPILOT-FPV-GAME
An absence is not a non-existence.
